modules.name: GTDefs
modules.source:
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Powerset

namespace GT

/-- Edge sets: ordered pairs (u, v), read as the edge {u, v}. Hosts list each edge once, with u < v. -/
abbrev Edges := Finset (ℕ × ℕ)

/-- No three edges (a, b), (b, c), (a, c). -/
def TriangleFree (S : Edges) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, ∀ g ∈ S, ¬ (e.1 = g.1 ∧ e.2 = f.1 ∧ f.2 = g.2)

instance (S : Edges) : Decidable (TriangleFree S) := by
  unfold TriangleFree; infer_instance

end GT

modules.name: QTDefs
modules.source:
import GTDefs

namespace QT

/-- Quotient lift: the host edges whose block pair lies in the pattern `Q` (B20_R26, generated:quotient-pattern-v1). -/
def lift (q : ℕ → ℕ) (Q : GT.Edges) (H : GT.Edges) : GT.Edges := H.filter (fun e => (q e.1, q e.2) ∈ Q)

end QT

modules.name: QTConj
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import QTDefs
set_option linter.unusedVariables false

namespace QTConj
/-- Generated conjecture `quotient_image` (generated:quotient-pattern-v1). -/
def quotient_image : Prop := ∀ (q : ℕ → ℕ) (Q : GT.Edges) (H : GT.Edges), QT.lift q Q H ⊆ H
/-- Generated conjecture `quotient_sound_tf` (generated:quotient-pattern-v1). -/
def quotient_sound_tf : Prop := ∀ (q : ℕ → ℕ) (Q : GT.Edges) (H : GT.Edges) (hQ : GT.TriangleFree Q), GT.TriangleFree (QT.lift q Q H)
end QTConj

modules.name: QTP1
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import QTDefs
import QTConj
namespace QTP1
theorem proof : QTConj.quotient_image := by
  unfold QTConj.quotient_image
  intro q Q H
  unfold QT.lift
  exact Finset.filter_subset _ _
end QTP1

modules.name: QTP2
modules.source:
import GTDefs
import QTDefs
import QTConj
import QTP1
namespace QTP2
theorem proof : QTConj.quotient_sound_tf := by
  unfold QTConj.quotient_sound_tf
  intro q Q H hQ
  unfold GT.TriangleFree QT.lift
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ he ⟨b', d⟩ hf ⟨a', d'⟩ hg ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at he hf hg
  simp only at h1 h2 h3
  subst h1 h2 h3
  exact hQ _ he.2 _ hf.2 _ hg.2 ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
end QTP2
